digest.component_or_area: test suite: subprocess and network reliability oracles
propositions: test_slow_but_progressing_remote_is_not_aborted uses production 10s low-speed window and 15s real loopback server, consuming 15+ seconds per test run despite checking only throughput floor semantics and stall classification

test_read_retried_then_terminal uses production 1s call timeout plus real 2s/4s backoff sleeps across three spawned processes, consuming ~9s elapsed time despite verifying only exact attempt count, logical retry schedule, and process cleanup

injecting sub-second test-only window/timeout values (1s, 0.1s) while retaining real loopback sockets and subprocess spawning can preserve production semantics and coverage while reducing wall time to low single-digit seconds
recorder-based logical retry schedule assertion can replace real sleep execution without affecting production code or defaults
post-terminal PID polling can prove process group cleanup without brittle wall-clock pass thresholds
